    from pcprest p, pcclient c
    where TRUNC(p.dtvenc) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    and p.codcli = c.codcli
    and p.dtpag is null
    and c.telcelent is not null
-- filtro de teste removido
    and codfilial not in (0)
    and p.codcob in ('000')
